## Installing Tools

Use `mise use backend:package@version` to install a CLI through a built-in backend and record it in project configuration. Run these examples from your project directory; add `-g` for global defaults. Use `mise exec -- <command>` to run an installed tool without shell activation.

| Backend | Project installation example | Discover packages |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| [npm](https://mise.jdx.dev/dev-tools/backends/npm.html) | `mise use node@24 npm:prettier@3` | [Awesome BUNX](https://github.com/carlosferreyra/awesome-bunx) |
| [PyPI](https://mise.jdx.dev/dev-tools/backends/pypi.html) | `mise use python@3.14 uv pypi:black` | [Awesome UVX](https://github.com/carlosferreyra/awesome-uvx) |
| [Cargo](https://mise.jdx.dev/dev-tools/backends/cargo.html) | `mise use rust@stable cargo:eza` | [Awesome Cargo Install](https://github.com/carlosferreyra/awesome-cargo-install) |

The examples include the runtime or installer prerequisites. Cargo source builds may also need a linker and native libraries; optional `cargo-binstall` can use available prebuilt binaries. Omitted package versions request `latest`; select a version when you need a fixed release. The sibling lists help you discover packages: use the package or crate name with the corresponding mise backend, and check its requirements. bunx and uvx are alternative runners, rather than mise backend names. See [all backends](https://mise.jdx.dev/dev-tools/backends/) for other installation sources.

## Integrations

- [intellij-mise](https://github.com/134130/intellij-mise) - Connect mise-managed SDKs and tasks to JetBrains IDEs.
- [mise-action](https://github.com/jdx/mise-action) - Install project tools in GitHub Actions so CI can use the same mise configuration as contributors.
- [mise-vscode](https://github.com/hverlin/mise-vscode) - Discover and run project tasks, manage tools, and work with the mise environment from VS Code.

<a id="choose-project-tools"></a>

## Tools

- [jq](https://jqlang.org/manual/) - Turn JSON exports and API responses into filtered records, aggregates, or input for another command. Registry key: `jq`.
- [Pandoc](https://pandoc.org/) - Convert documents between formats and build repeatable publishing workflows from source files. Registry key: `pandoc`.
- [Rclone](https://rclone.org/) - Copy, inspect, and synchronize files across local storage and cloud providers. Registry key: `rclone`.
- [yq](https://mikefarah.gitbook.io/yq) - Query and transform YAML with the Mike Farah implementation of yq, including conversion between structured data formats. Registry key: `yq`.

## Workflows & Recipes

- [CSV category totals](examples/csv-category-totals/README.md) - Summarize a CSV by category into a JSON report, with a preparation task creating the output directory.
- [Document inventory](examples/document-inventory/README.md) - Create a CSV of relative file paths and byte sizes, with input and output locations set by the project environment.
- [Portable notes archive](examples/notes-archive/README.md) - Package a notes directory into a gzip-compressed tar archive using a named task.
